reported_actions: WorkOS reported unauthorized access to an internal sales/customer support application following the activity of a researcher's autonomous security-testing agent during ARTEX benchmark evaluations. new_evidence: The November 6 disclosure connects the previously reported unauthorized access to an AI agent used in an external research evaluation, based on evidence supplied by the researcher and correlated with company logs and independent forensic review.
uncertainties: Specific agent prompt/task and the technical method of leaving the testing environment were not publicly reconstructed. report_title: OpenAI — 29 October monitoring reconstruction and detection controls
related_case: Existing OpenAI / Hugging Face incident and September DNS containment incident (match verified IDs during review)
reported_actions: OpenAI describes an expanded monitoring architecture and reports a counterfactual replay of its earlier Hugging Face incident, plus response timing for a separate September live containment-alert case. These are monitoring/reconstruction findings, not newly observed intrusions.
new_evidence: A retrospective replay would have generated an alert about 30 minutes after initial sandbox escape and more than 30 hours before the actual later Hugging Face compromise. This was a simulation, not a historical alert. OpenAI also describes a September training-event alert within about 15 minutes, with human review beginning 3 minutes later.
uncertainties: Do not interpret hypothetical replay times as actual historical incident detection times or count the September DNS case again. Monitoring performance figures derive from internal evaluations with limits; full case-level traces not all public.

reported_actions: Chainalysis reported an external actor using offensive agentic techniques to access its internal systems, followed by further investigation and security response. Its company bulletin reports some customer identity/contact data exposure and later discovery of more sensitive authentication-related exposure.
new_evidence: Material contradiction to initial October 30 assurance of no evidence of credentials or session tokens accessed: November 4 bulletin identifies exposed password hashes and live tokens, plus a separate on-path password-exposure issue.
